sloka: एवम् उक्त्वा महाबाहुः अगस्त्यम् सूर्य वर्चसम् ।जग्राह आपतत् तस्य पादौ च रघुनन्दन ॥३-१२-२४॥
transliteration: evam uktvā mahābāhuḥ agastyam sūrya varcasam ।jagrāha āpatat tasya pādau ca raghunandana ॥3-12-24॥

translations.english: Having said so, the mightyarmed Rama, the scorcher of enemies, grasped the feet of Agastya who was shining like the Sun.
